changes.evidence: Runaways S3 episode 4: Morgan le Fay heals the comatose Robert with a spell that puts him under her control (a crow necklace keeps the enchantment). Enthralled, he becomes her lover and serves the coven's plan: in episode 6 he names le Fay the new CEO of Wizard and helps plan the worldwide Corvus phone launch (the coven page: the Coven took over Wizard through its enthralled founder). In episode 7 Tina breaks the necklace, freeing him; he turns on le Fay, helping Tina and Nico steal the Darkhold, and le Fay kills him. Forced/enthralled service counts (cf. the dataset's Geoffrey Wilder, whose enthralled S3 service is followed by The Pride again). Uses the dataset's existing name 'Morgan's coven' (Nico's record). The return to The Pride after he turns on the coven mirrors Geoffrey's record; if the owner prefers, the tail could instead be a left title 'Runaways S3'.

Runaways S3 episode 7: besides his job at Wizard, Geoffrey is enthralled by Morgan le Fay through a crow necklace (the coven page: 'the Coven gained an asset when le Fay was able to enthral Geoffrey Wilder') and acts as the coven's thrall: he tricks Victor Stein and Stacey Yorkes and locks them up 'under Morgan le Fay's orders', and holds the captured Runaways at Wizard HQ with the coven's affiliates. In episode 8 he wakes free of the spell and in episode 9 reassembles the Pride (already recorded). Enthralled service counts (precedent: Stane under the Hood). Uses the dataset's existing name 'Morgan's coven'.
